description: Traffic Signals Status is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This dataset reports on the operation state of traffic signals in Austin, TX. Traffic signals enter flash mode when something is preventing the signal from operating normally. This is typically the result of a power surge, power outage, or damage to signal equipment. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are traffic signals, roadways, transit, transportation, mobility. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
